description: Return a representative sample of addresses on OceanAlt's reviewed risk list — OFAC-sanctioned, known mixers, and community-reported scam/phishing — each with its source category and the reason it was flagged. Useful for grounding, showing an agent/user what gets blocked and why, or a quick read on the current threat surface. Takes no arguments. Free, no API key.
name: recent_flagged
title: List recently flagged high-risk addresses (free)
